name: Bicycle repair shop
summary: How expats use bicycle repair shops in Singapore — tune-ups after Park Connector rides, e-bike rules awareness, and flat-prone wet-season maintenance.
body:
Bike shops handle punctures, gear tunes, brake swaps, and fitting advice for PCN commuting. Wet-season flats and rusty chains are common. E-bike and PMD rules are separate — shops can advise but LTA rules still govern what you ride.

## Typical jobs
- Puncture repair and puncture-resist setups
- Gear / brake tunes after rain commuting
- Bike fit basics for new frames
- Child seat and trailer installs
- Folding-bike hinge and wheel service

Ask about turnaround before Monday commuting needs.

## How to choose
Prefer shops that road-test gears after service and show worn pads/chains before replacing. Confirm parts brands and warranty. For e-bikes, ask whether they service your specific system.

## Practical tip
Photo the drivetrain and note recent noises before drop-off. Vague “it clicks sometimes” diagnoses waste a service slot.
